items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Dinah Washington was just about the same way. She had to curse the audience out.

ctx.x: twice or three times. Now which bands used to rehearse a lot? What bands?

Lionel Hampton. He rehearse, every day that you work, whether you need it or not. And the purpose was? I found out the real purpose why he rehearsed so much. See one time when I got back with the band I said, look, I'm going to make one rehearsal a week. And if I make more than one rehearsal a week, I want to get paid for the rehearsal. So one day he didn't rehearse, and he had to play Midnight Sun, this is the thing that he wrote. And he played that every night. He couldn't play it. See like when he, because he…

demanding, was it, that you played with in road bands? Demanding in which way? In music, musically demanding. Who was the most musically demanding? Basie. Basie. And was he hard on you as a disciplinarian, as a person?
